H2190.name: Zaavan
H2190.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2190.brief: Horite chief, descendant of Seir the Horite
H2190.short: Zaavan, a Horite chief, was a descendant of Seir the Horite.

H2140.name: Zaccai
H2140.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2140.short: Zaccai was the ancestor of a family that returned to Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H2139I.name: Zaccur
H2139I.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2139I.short: Zaccur was a Merarite Levite, one of the sons of Jaaziah.

H2139J.name: Zaccur
H2139J.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2139J.brief: Son of Asaph, a musician in David's time
H2139J.short: Zaccur, a son of Asaph, was a musician during the reigns of David and Solomon.

H2139H.name: Zaccur
H2139H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2139H.short: Zaccur was a Simeonite mentioned in the genealogy of Mishma.

H2139K.name: Zaccur
H2139K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2139K.brief: Leader of returning exiles with Shecaniah
H2139K.short: Zaccur, along with Shecaniah, led a group of returning exiles to Jerusalem.

H2139M.name: Zaccur
H2139M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2139M.short: Zaccur, a priest, was among those who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H2139N.name: Zaccur
H2139N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2139N.short: Zaccur, a priest, was appointed as one of the treasurers by Nehemiah.

H2139L.name: Zaccur
H2139L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2139L.brief: Son of Imri, helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall
H2139L.short: Zaccur, son of Imri, participated in rebuilding a section of Jerusalem's wall.

H2139G.name: Zaccur
H2139G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2139G.short: Zaccur, son of Shammua, was the Reubenite representative among the twelve spies sent to explore Canaan.

H2117.name: Zaza
H2117.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2117.brief: Son of Jonathan, descendant of Jerahmeel
H2117.short: Zaza was a son of Jonathan and a descendant of Jerahmeel from the tribe of Judah.

H2148E.name: Zechariah
H2148E.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148E.short: Zechariah, son of Isshiah, was a Levite mentioned in the genealogical records of the Levites during the reign of David.

H2148F.name: Zechariah
H2148F.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148F.short: Zechariah was the fourth son of Hosah, a Merarite.

H2148G.name: Zechariah
H2148G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148G.brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh
H2148G.short: Zechariah, son of Obadiah, was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead during the reign of David.

H2148D.name: Zechariah
H2148D.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148D.brief: Reubenite chief during the reign of Jotham
H2148D.short: Zechariah was a chief of the tribe of Reuben during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

H2148A.name: Zechariah
H2148A.desc: Singer living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148A.brief: Levite gatekeeper and musician during David's reign
H2148A.short: Zechariah, a Levite, served as a gatekeeper and musician in the tabernacle during the time of King David.

H2148H.name: Zechariah
H2148H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148H.brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
H2148H.short: Zechariah was one of the Levites sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

H2148I.name: Zechariah
H2148I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148I.brief: Levite who prophesied during Jehoshaphat's reign
H2148I.short: Zechariah, a Levite who prophesied during Jehoshaphat's reign.

H2148J.name: Zechariah
H2148J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148J.brief: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah
H2148J.short: Zechariah, one of the sons of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah.

H2148w.name: Zechariah
H2148w.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148w.brief: Priest murdered in the temple court
H2148w.short: Zechariah, son of Jehoiada the priest, was murdered in the temple court.

H2148L.name: Zechariah
H2148L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148L.short: Zechariah, a prophet who instructed King Uzziah in the fear of God.

H2148M.name: Zechariah
H2148M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148M.short: Zechariah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, helped cleanse the temple during Hezekiah's reign.

H2148N.name: Zechariah
H2148N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148N.brief: Levite who helped repair the temple under Josiah
H2148N.short: Zechariah, a Levite who helped repair the temple during Josiah's reign.

H2148O.name: Zechariah
H2148O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148O.brief: Leader who contributed to Josiah's Passover
H2148O.short: Zechariah, a leader who generously contributed to Josiah's Passover celebration.

H2148P.name: Zechariah
H2148P.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148P.brief: Last king of the northern kingdom of Israel
H2148P.short: Zechariah, son of Jeroboam II, was the last king of the northern kingdom of Israel, reigning for only six months before being assassinated.

H2148C.name: Zechariah
H2148C.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148C.brief: Mentioned in the genealogy of King Hezekiah
H2148C.short: Zechariah is mentioned as the father of Abijah (or Abi), the mother of King Hezekiah of Judah.

H2148T.name: Zechariah
H2148T.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148T.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman
H2148T.short: Zechariah, an Israelite who married a foreign woman during the exile.

H2148v.name: Zechariah
H2148v.desc: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148v.brief: Post-exilic prophet who wrote the book of Zechariah
H2148v.short: Zechariah, a post-exilic prophet and priest who wrote the book bearing his name.

H2148R.name: Zechariah
H2148R.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148R.brief: Descendant of Bebai who returned with Ezra
H2148R.short: Zechariah, a descendant of Bebai, who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H2148S.name: Zechariah
H2148S.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148S.brief: Levite sent by Ezra to find ministers
H2148S.short: Zechariah, a man of understanding, sent by Ezra to find ministers for the house of God.

H2148Q.name: Zechariah
H2148Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148Q.brief: Descendant of Parosh who returned with Ezra
H2148Q.short: Zechariah, a descendant of Parosh, who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H2148z.name: Zechariah
H2148z.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2148z.brief: Witness to Isaiah's prophecy about Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz
H2148z.short: Zechariah, son of Jeberechiah, was a faithful witness to Isaiah's prophecy about his son Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

H2148X.name: Zechariah
H2148X.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148X.brief: Priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile
H2148X.short: Zechariah, a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile, was the son of Pashhur (or 'Pashur').

H2148V.name: Zechariah
H2148V.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148V.brief: Descendant of Perez who lived in Jerusalem
H2148V.short: Zechariah, a descendant of Perez, who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

H2148W.name: Zechariah
H2148W.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148W.brief: Descendant of Shelah who lived in Jerusalem
H2148W.short: Zechariah, a descendant of Shelah, who settled in Jerusalem after the exile.

H2148Y.name: Zechariah
H2148Y.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148Y.brief: Head of the priestly family of Iddo
H2148Y.short: Zechariah was the head of the priestly family of Iddo during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

H2148Z.name: Zechariah
H2148Z.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148Z.brief: Priest who played a trumpet in the procession
H2148Z.short: Zechariah, son of Jonathan, was a priest who played a trumpet in the procession at Jerusalem's wall dedication.

H2148y.name: Zechariah
H2148y.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148y.brief: Priest who participated in the wall dedication
H2148y.short: Zechariah, a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H2148U.name: Zechariah
H2148U.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2148U.brief: Levite who assisted Ezra in reading the Law
H2148U.short: Zechariah, a Levite who stood beside Ezra when he read the Law to the people.

H2144.name: Zecher
H2144.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H2144.brief: Son of Abiel, founder of Gibeon
H2144.short: Zecher (or Zechariah), a son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel'), the father (and founder) of Gibeon.

H2160.name: Zemirah
H2160.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2160.short: Zemirah was a son of Becher and grandson of Benjamin.

H2133.name: Zethan
H2133.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2133.short: Zethan was a son of Bilhan and a descendant of Benjamin.

H2127.name: Zia
H2127.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2127.brief: Gadite clan leader during the reign of Jotham
H2127.short: Zia was a Gadite clan leader during the reigns of Jotham, king of Judah, and Jeroboam, king of Israel.

H2147L.name: Zichri
H2147L.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2147L.short: Zichri, a Levite descendant of Moses, was a treasurer in the temple during the time of David.

H2147M.name: Zichri
H2147M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2147M.brief: Leader of the tribe of Reuben
H2147M.short: Zichri was the leader of the tribe of Reuben during the reign of King David.

H2147H.name: Zichri
H2147H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2147H.short: Zichri was a son of Shimei, a Benjamite, and a descendant of Shaharaim.

H2147I.name: Zichri
H2147I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2147I.short: Zichri was a son of Jeroham, a Benjamite, and a descendant of Shaharaim.

H2147J.name: Zichri
H2147J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2147J.short: Zichri was another son of Jeroham, a Benjamite, and a descendant of Shaharaim.

H2147K.name: Zichri
H2147K.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H2147K.brief: Levite, descendant of Asaph, temple singer
H2147K.short: Zichri (or Zabdi), a Levite descendant of Asaph, was a temple singer during the time of Nehemiah.

H2147N.name: Zichri
H2147N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2147N.short: Zichri was a commander of 200,000 soldiers who volunteered to serve King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

H2147O.name: Zichri
H2147O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2147O.brief: Father of Elishaphat, a supporter of Jehoiada
H2147O.short: Zichri was the father of Elishaphat, one of the commanders who supported Jehoiada the priest in overthrowing Athaliah.

H2147P.name: Zichri
H2147P.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2147P.brief: Ephraimite warrior who killed Maaseiah, Ahaziah, and Elkanah
H2147P.short: Zichri, a mighty warrior from Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king's son, Ahaziah the governor, and Elkanah the second to the king during the reign of Ahaz.

H2147G.name: Zichri
H2147G.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2147G.short: Zichri was a son of Izhar and grandson of Kohath, of the tribe of Levi.

H2147Q.name: Zichri
H2147Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2147Q.brief: Son of Joab, a leader in Jerusalem
H2147Q.short: Zichri, the son of Joab, was a leader in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

H2147R.name: Zichri
H2147R.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2147R.brief: Head of the priestly family of Abijah
H2147R.short: Zichri was the head of the priestly family of Abijah during the time of Joiakim the high priest.

H2153.name: Zilpah
H2153.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2153.brief: Leah's maidservant; mother of Gad and Asher
H2153.short: Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, bore Jacob two sons, Gad and Asher.

H2155G.name: Zimmah
H2155G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2155G.brief: Levite, son of Shimei, descendant of Gershon
H2155G.short: Zimmah, a Levite and descendant of Gershon, was the son of Shimei.

H2155H.name: Zimmah
H2155H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2155H.brief: Levite, son of Asaph, during Hezekiah's reign
H2155H.short: Zimmah, a Levite and son of Asaph, participated in the purification of the temple during King Hezekiah's reign.

H2175.name: Zimran
H2175.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2175.short: Zimran was one of the sons born to Abraham and his wife Keturah after the death of Sarah.

H2174H.name: Zimri
H2174H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2174H.short: Zimri, a Benjamite, was the son of Jehoadah and is mentioned in the genealogies of Benjamin.

H2174A.name: Zimri
H2174A.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2174A.brief: King of Israel, reigned seven days
H2174A.short: Zimri, a commander of half of Israel's chariots, became king after assassinating Elah, but his reign lasted only seven days.

H2174G.name: Zimri
H2174G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2174G.brief: Simeonite prince, killed in the Baal-Peor incident
H2174G.short: Zimri, a prince of the Simeonites, was one of the Israelites killed in the incident involving the worship of Baal-Peor.

H2128J.name: Ziph
H2128J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2128J.short: Ziph, a descendant of Judah, was one of the sons of Jehallelel.

H2129.name: Ziphah
H2129.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2129.short: Ziphah, a descendant of Judah, was one of the sons of Jehallelel.

H2124G.name: Ziza
H2124G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2124G.short: Ziza, a descendant of Simeon, was the son of Shiphi.

H2124H.name: Ziza
H2124H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2124H.brief: Son of King Rehoboam and Maacah
H2124H.short: Ziza was one of the sons born to King Rehoboam of Judah and his wife Maacah, the granddaughter of Absalom.

H2125.name: Zizah
H2125.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2125.short: Zizah (or Zina), a Gershonite Levite, was the second son of Shimei.

H2105.name: Zoheth
H2105.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2105.short: Zoheth was a son of Ishi and a descendant of Judah.

H2104.name: Zuzim
H2104.short: The Zuzim were an ancient people defeated by Chedorlaomer and his allies during Abraham's time.

H2132G.name: Olives Mount
H2132G.brief: A mountain ridge east of Jerusalem
H2132G.short: The Mount of Olives is a mountain ridge east of Jerusalem, known as the site of many significant events in the Bible, particularly in the life of Jesus.

H2182G.name: Zanoah
H2182G.brief: A town in the Judean lowlands allotted to Judah
H2182G.short: Zanoah, a town in the Judean lowlands allotted to Judah, whose inhabitants helped rebuild the Valley Gate during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Josh. 15:34; 1Chr. 4:18; Neh. 3:13; 11:30">Josh. 15:34; 1Chr. 4:18; Neh. 3:13; 11:30</ref>).

H2182H.name: Zanoah
H2182H.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah
H2182H.short: Zanoah, a town in the hill country of Judah, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to the tribe (<ref="Josh. 15:56">Josh. 15:56</ref>).

H2174B.name: Zimri
H2174B.brief: A nation mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy against nations
H2174B.short: Zimri was a nation mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy of God's judgment against various nations .

H2128G.name: Ziph
H2128G.brief: A town in the Negev of Judah
H2128G.short: Ziph was a town in the Negev region of Judah .

H2128H.name: Ziph
H2128H.brief: A town in Judah where David hid from Saul
H2128H.short: Ziph was a town in the hill country of Judah where David hid from Saul in the nearby wilderness .
